guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the largest anomalies: latency-90 rose from 0.0096 to 1.16 (z=+2400), CPU rose about 620% (2.63 to 18.95), and memory rose about 545%. The frontend latency increase and the slow, errored traces all pass through recommendationservice, while its downstream productcatalogservice stays flat (CPU -10.6%, latency-50 +6.2%), so the fault originates in recommendationservice itself.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or reschedule the recommendationservice pods and apply CPU limits or autoscaling, then profile the service for the runaway CPU use. Check whether the memory growth is a side effect or a separate leak.
